attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; Gmail API v1 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Gmail API v1, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20261116) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (79 operations) plus the media-upload endpoints of the 6 methods that take file content (12 operations: the simple /upload/... and resumable /resumable/upload/... paths, absolute from rootUrl) and every Discovery schema (56 components) is modelled. The gmail adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders.
